name: NVIDIA Auto Ontology
description: Builds governed business ontologies from enterprise metadata and serves that business context to agents over MCP, a CLI and an API.

skills.name: Generate ontologies
skills.description: Generates enterprise ontologies from metadata and connects existing ontologies and semantic models.

skills.name: Ground agents in business meaning
skills.description: Grounds agents in trusted definitions of business metrics, entities and relationships, reconciling inconsistent sources.

skills.name: Learn from corrections
skills.description: Folds certified corrections and usage back into the ontology so the shared context improves with use.
